note: McCrary rdd::DCdensity strongly rejects (p~0, theta>0) at both thresholds in this Mixtape SUBSET, diverging from the paper's p=0.59/0.38 (full 512,964-obs sample). The raw local density ratio is only ~1.14 (0.08) and ~0.96 (0.15), i.e. a modest step, so the large theta is a local-linear density-fit artifact: the BAC pmf is heavily discrete (~400 ties) and strongly curved, and n=214k inflates the z-stat. This is exactly the discrete/rounded case the paper cites Frandsen (2013) for. The Frandsen reimplementation does NOT reject at either threshold (consistent with the paper's no-manipulation conclusion), though the exact p-values differ from 0.795/0.886 (different smoothness parameterization).
